contexts.text: The fruit or offspring of the heavenly marriage.
The offspring of a beast () = the affection of good; thus the good of charity.
Truths are thence produced as offspring from their parents: these offspring are from the marriage of good and truth.
The child which she would bear () = the doctrine of the New Church. AE 722.
Her child was caught up to God and to His throne () = the protection of the doctrine by the Lord, because it was for the New Church, and its being guarded by the Angels. AE 728. See AE 670:end.
See Offspring.
This first of this love... after the birth passes fully to the offspring.
The loving, conception, gestation of the embryo or offspring to be procreated (are the series of causes); and the effect is the procreated offspring itself.
Monstrous births from the faith of the present Church. Enumerated.
Thus some birth representing the creation of the universe may be begotten.
Such a paralytic offspring is born from this...
They bring forth a two headed offspring.
(Effect upon the offspring of powerful emotions excited in the mother at the time of conception and after it.)
(The Spirits of the renal capsules) are those who have performed the chief work in foetuses and infants.
That little ones and infants are carried to Heaven by a very short way represented by the cuticular ducts. (Compare SE 1022.)
As in the foetus every membrane has been sanguineous, and its fibres afterwards as it were not sanguineous...
Those who most tenderly love infants, so that [they love] only foetuses and infants...

The preacher was seen to stand before a woman who was as it were bringing forth, in the desire to devour the child when it came forth... The doctrine of the New Church was presented representatively by the child.
The offspring of thy oxen () = their exterior affections.
Thereby all the subsequent births were sanctified also.

The heifer and the bear shall feed, and their young ones shall lie down together () = the power and desire of the natural man to falsify the truths of the Word, and that these shall not hurt the good of the natural man and its affection...
5. This motion is not from any life proper to the foetus... The finality of the life of the foetus in the womb. Explained.
Nothing whatever of will and understanding belongs to the foetus in its formation. Explained.
